name: exists_rapid_with_realSlice
summary: Take κ = (∫τ)⁻¹ and the section with slices τ(x)κ·realWeil(1, v) (`exists_section`); its slice at 0 for the opposite splitting is the integral of the slices, which is (∫τ)κ·v = v, checked on zero terms.

steps.claim: The integral I = ∫τ (real measure) is positive (τ continuous, compactly supported, non-negative, τ(y) ≠ 0), hence a unit of ℂ: choose κ with I·κ = 1 (this).

By the existence of sections (`exists_section`: a smooth compactly supported coefficient times a fixed rapid vector) there is a rapid Λ whose slice at each x is τ(x)κ·realWeil(1, v) (l); it remains that realSlice(D.symm, V′, 0, Λ) = v, which is checked on zero terms against every datum f (`eq_of_integrated_zeroTerm_eq`).
steps.lean:
refine (exists_section _ (c.smul_const _) k.smul_right contDiff_const hv).imp fun _ ↦
    .imp_right fun l ↦ ⟨eq_of_integrated_zeroTerm_eq (isAdapted_homSource D.symm V') fun f ↦ ?_, l⟩

steps.claim: The zero term of the slice for the opposite splitting is the integral over x of the zero terms of the slices of Λ (`symm_homSource_zeroTerm_eq_integral`, used twice), the integral commutes with the integrated datum, and the vacuum measure transported by the adapted basis is a multiple of the Haar measure (`isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul`).
steps.lean:
erw [← zeroTerm_integrated, symm_homSource_zeroTerm_eq_integral,
    symm_homSource_zeroTerm_eq_integral, ← (integrated _ v).integral_comp_comm (by fun_prop),
    @isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ volume _
    (.domSMul (μ := vacuumMeasure) (.mk (star (adaptedHomBasis b V'))))]

steps.claim: Simplify the transported integral (integration against a transported measure) and the mixed terms of integrated data (`mixedTerm_integrated`).
Write the integral over the adelic sum as an iterated integral and insert the slices of Λ (l).
The result is (∫τ)·κ times the zero term of v, and I·κ = 1 (this).
